For any concrete exposed to freezing temperatures and moisture, the air content shall be the greater of 5%, minimum required by ACI 318, or of that shown in the table.
Tolerance on air content as delivered shall be +/- 1.5%.

Slump tolerances as follows (ACI 117):
Specified Slump not greater than 4"= +/- 1"
Specified Slump more than 4"= +/- 1 1/2"
Where Slump is specified as a range= No Tolerance
See ACI 301 for slump of concrete before addition of plasticizers or high-range water reducing admixtures.
Refer to concrete column schedule for additional strength requirements.
Unless otherwise approved by structural engineer.
Type I/II cement shall conform to ASTM C150, Type II cement shall conform to ASTM C150, Type IL cement shall conform to ASTM C595.
Refer to Specifications for Global Warming Potential Limits and Environmental Performance Documentation and Requirements
Strength (f'c) is the compressive strength at 28 days unless noted otherwise or compressive strength at the specified age.

Concrete is normal weight concrete unless noted otherwise. Normal weight concrete (NW) shall have a dry density of 145 ± 5 pcf unless noted otherwise. Lightweight concrete (LW) shall have a dry density of 110 ± 5 pcf unless noted otherwise.
Required minimum average splitting tensile strength = 6.7*√(f'c) regardless of concrete density.
Mix designs shall be in accordance with ACI 301.

Exposure Class indicates the severity of the anticipated exposure of concrete members for each exposure indicated below according to ACI 318 Table 19.3.1.1/ACI 301:
Freeze Thaw Exposure noted thus: F0,F1,F2,F3
Water-Soluble Sulfate in Soil Exposure noted thus: S0,S1,S2,S3
Permeability Requirements noted thus: W0,W1
Corrosion Protection of Reinforcement noted thus: C0,C1,C2
Refer to ACI 301/ACI 318 for specific requirements based on the exposure category indicated in the mix design table above.

EDIT FOOTNOTES AND ELEMENT TYPES TO SUIT PROJECT. FOR EACH ELEMENT TYPE, ASSIGN AN EXPOSURE CLASS BASED ON EXPECTED EXPOSURE. IT IS NOT RECOMMENDED TO SPECIFY CEMENT TYPE, MAX W/C, OR AIR CONTENT UNLESS REQUIRED FOR EXPOSURE CLASS (SEE NOTE 2 ABOVE).

TESTING AT 56 DAYS FOR THESE MIX DESIGNS IS PROPOSED TO ALLOW FOR REDUCTION IN CEMENT CONTENT FOR THESE MIXES. COORDINATE AVAILABILITY OF 56 DAY TEST DATA WITH CONCRETE MIX SUPPLIER AND MAKE CONTRACTOR AWARE OF THIS REQUIREMENT DURING DESIGN.
TESTING AT 56 DAYS FOR THESE MIX DESIGNS MAY BE APPROPRIATE DEPENDING ON PROJECT CONDITIONS AND TIMING OF PLACEMENT OF BACKFILL. COORDINATE WITH CONTRACTOR DURING DESIGN IF POSSIBLE.
DEFAULT IS TO NOT SPECIFY SLUMP EXCEPT AT DRILLED PIERS. SUPPLIER SHALL DETERMINE TARGET SLUMP FOR MIX DESIGN AND MEASURED SLUMPS SHALL REMAIN WITHIN THE TOLERANCE INDICATED.
